phases.name: Slice-01: WhatsApp call from the home card
phases.description: Shipped 2026-08-10. The home card exposes the completed Spanish call through a normal WhatsApp link, including when JavaScript is off.

steps.name: Compose the Spanish call
criteria: A populated daily call produces the complete Spanish message.
The message carries no technical or placeholder text.
The message and top card name the same spot and score.
steps.scenario_name: El mensaje y la página cuentan la misma historia, sin texto técnico
steps.non_visual_rationale: Historical pure composition work. The mounted home action was examined in 01-04.
steps.implementation_notes: Shipped evidence is retained in the execution log. Future changes keep the call message pure and preserve the accepted home behavior.

steps.name: Create the stamped share address
criteria: A shared address is absolute and follows the configured site.
The shared address includes the published build stamp.
Changing the configured site changes the shared address.
steps.scenario_name: La dirección del mensaje sigue a la configuración del sitio, nunca a un nombre fijo
steps.non_visual_rationale: Historical address composition work. The mounted home action was examined in 01-04.
steps.implementation_notes: Shipped evidence is retained in the execution log. Later slices reuse this configured-site behavior.

steps.name: Render the home WhatsApp action
criteria: The control is a single accessible WhatsApp link.
The control remains readable and tappable at phone width.
The control does not require JavaScript.
steps.scenario_name: La acción de compartir se ve terminada y respeta las preferencias del teléfono
steps.non_visual_rationale: Historical component work. The built page did not expose the action until 01-04.
steps.implementation_notes: Shipped evidence is retained in the execution log. The visible quality gate belongs to the mounted behavior.

steps.name: Mount the home WhatsApp action
criteria: The top home card offers one WhatsApp action.
The action opens the completed call from the card's own data.
The home remains within its first-flight budget.
steps.scenario_name: Un toque abre WhatsApp con el llamado del día ya escrito
steps.u8_observation: Un toque en la acción de WhatsApp de la tarjeta grande abre WhatsApp con el mensaje completo ya escrito: SURF y la fecha, Mejor: con el spot y su puntaje, el tamaño y el viento, la ventana, Confianza con el nivel, y una dirección https que termina en ?b= con el sello del build. El mismo enlace y el mismo mensaje con JavaScript apagado.
steps.implementation_notes: Shipped. The accepted seam is the singular top-card-action slot in RankedList; do not create another home-card path.

phases.name: Slice-02: copy the call from the home card
phases.description: A surfer copies the exact home call with one tap. Failure, offline use, JavaScript-off fallback, budget, and phone-quality states remain honest.

steps.name: Copy the completed home call
criteria: One tap copies the same complete call offered by WhatsApp.
A Spanish confirmation appears only after the copy succeeds.
The user can paste the copied call elsewhere unchanged.
steps.scenario_name: Un toque deja el llamado completo en el portapapeles

scenario_mappings.scenario_name: Un toque deja el llamado completo en el portapapeles

steps.non_visual_rationale: This establishes the copy outcome before the mounted surface receives its visible quality gate.
steps.implementation_notes: Use the existing WhatsApp call as the sole source of copied text. Keep the outcome observable through the browser acceptance test.

steps.name: Show an honest copy failure
criteria: A denied copy is explained in plain Spanish.
No success confirmation appears after a denied copy.
The WhatsApp action remains available.
steps.scenario_name: Si el teléfono niega el portapapeles, la página lo dice claro y WhatsApp sigue ahí

scenario_mappings.scenario_name: Si el teléfono niega el portapapeles, la página lo dice claro y WhatsApp sigue ahí

steps.non_visual_rationale: This is the recovery behavior of the same copy surface; the combined visible gate is 02-03.
steps.implementation_notes: The fallback must leave the shipped WhatsApp route usable.

steps.name: Close the home copy journey
criteria: Copy works after the page is loaded without network access.
The copy enhancement stays within its deferred budget.
No dead copy control is offered without JavaScript.
Both home actions pass the phone-quality checks.
steps.scenario_name: La mejora de copiar viaja liviana y nunca reemplaza el piso

scenario_mappings.scenario_name: Copiar funciona sin señal, porque compartir no depende de ningún servidor

steps.u8_observation: Copiar confirma solo después de guardar el mismo bloque y WhatsApp sigue disponible si copiar falla o JavaScript está apagado.
steps.implementation_notes: Use the existing top-card-action surface. Run the full slice acceptance file and the charter examination after the journey is green.

phases.name: Slice-03: preview text names the home call
phases.description: A shared home address publishes a Spanish preview naming the best spot and its score, with a clean permanent address and no page-visible change.

steps.name: Describe the shared home call
criteria: The preview title and description name the same home spot and score.
Preview text is plain Spanish without technical filler.
A configured-site change changes preview addresses.
steps.scenario_name: El anuncio escrito cuenta completo el llamado del día

scenario_mappings.scenario_name: El anuncio escrito cuenta completo el llamado del día
El anuncio escrito cambia de dirección cuando cambia el sitio

steps.non_visual_rationale: This prepares preview content; a reader sees no new page surface until 03-03 publishes it.
steps.implementation_notes: Preserve one story between the shared call and the preview.

steps.name: Publish clean home preview metadata
criteria: A page can publish the preview metadata when it has a call.
Its permanent address has no shared build stamp.
Pages without a call keep their existing head.

scenario_mappings.scenario_name: La página base publica el anuncio preparado

steps.non_visual_rationale: This is a shared-head seam. The surfer-facing preview is asserted only after the home supplies it.
steps.implementation_notes: Serialized shared surface: complete this Base change before any later image metadata change.

steps.name: Close the home preview journey
criteria: The published home preview names the best spot and score.
The preview metadata stays inside the home document budget.
The preview can be checked against the published page and hosted paste.
steps.scenario_name: El anuncio del enlace nombra el mejor spot del día y trae su puntaje

scenario_mappings.scenario_name: El anuncio del enlace nombra el mejor spot del día y trae su puntaje
El anuncio cuenta la misma historia que el mensaje pegado, sin texto técnico
La dirección del anuncio deriva del sitio configurado, nunca de un nombre fijo
La dirección permanente de la página no carga el sello del build
El anuncio no engorda el primer vuelo

steps.u8_observation: La vista previa del enlace nombra el spot y su puntaje, con una dirección permanente limpia y sin texto técnico.
steps.implementation_notes: Serialized shared surface: use RankedList's established top-card-action path and pass the home preview through the same render route. Base.astro also mounts the canonical link because application-architecture.md §13 requires it to strip the shared ?b= stamp.

phases.name: Slice-04: preview card stays current
phases.description: The shared preview includes a readable image for each published spot, falls back honestly when data is incomplete, and is refreshed by each publication.

steps.name: Describe incomplete preview data honestly
criteria: Incomplete spot data selects a generic preview instead of invented values.
The missing data is recorded during publication.
A complete spot retains its own preview data.

steps.non_visual_rationale: This selects honest preview content; the visible preview card is published in 04-03.
steps.implementation_notes: The generic card is a declared recovery outcome, not a silent substitute.

steps.name: Publish a card for every spot
criteria: Every published spot has a preview card.
Each card tells that spot's own story.
The card meets the agreed preview size and weight limits.
steps.scenario_name: Cada spot publicado recibe su propia tarjeta en cada publicación

scenario_mappings.scenario_name: Cada spot publicado recibe su propia tarjeta en cada publicación

steps.implementation_notes: Publish the agreed per-spot-per-build cadence and retain the generic recovery asset.

steps.name: Close the preview card journey
criteria: The home preview declares its absolute image card.
A later publication shows the new card data.
Opening the home does not download the preview card.
The preview card is readable and intentional at chat size.
steps.scenario_name: El anuncio de la home declara su tarjeta, con las medidas y el peso acordados

scenario_mappings.scenario_name: El anuncio de la home declara su tarjeta, con las medidas y el peso acordados
Una mañana nueva rehace la tarjeta; lo viejo nunca se presenta como fresco

steps.u8_observation: La tarjeta de vista previa cuenta el spot, puntaje, tamaño y confianza del build compartido, sin una imagen rota ni números viejos.
steps.implementation_notes: Serialized shared surfaces: extend the Slice-03 preview path rather than creating a second head or home-card path.

phases.name: Slice-05: every spot shares its own call
phases.description: A surfer on a non-top spot page shares and copies that spot's own call, never the home call, while retaining the phone and route budgets.

steps.name: Share the selected spot's call
criteria: A spot page's WhatsApp message names that spot and score.
The shared address points to that spot's stamped page.
The message never substitutes the home call.

steps.name: Close the spot sharing journey
